# Systemia Decision Lab

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: systemia-decision-lab
Class: owner_workforce_decision_intelligence
Canonical URL: https://systemiadecisionlab.base44.app/
Authority: public owner-side workforce decision analysis; the free decision report structures alternatives while human judgment remains final
Human confirmation required: yes

## Natural-language intents
- should I hire an employee
- hire vs outsource
- hire vs automate
- should I promote or restructure instead of hiring
- what role actually solves this business problem
- compare the real cost of hiring before adding payroll

## Boundaries
- does not rank job candidates or make employment decisions
- does not replace lawful human review of applicants or employees
- a decision report is planning support rather than a legal or HR determination
- paid fulfillment requires provider-verified payment; checkout creation alone is not payment proof

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
